activity.notes: Moctezuma I (Ilhuicamina) succeeded Itzcoatl as huey tlatoani of Tenochtitlan in 1440 and ruled until 1469. ATLAS records the conventional year-level reign while keeping the polity identity consistent with the existing Aztec Empire record used for Moctezuma II.

sources.title: Moctezuma I, tlatoani que consolidó el imperio mexica — Secretaría de Cultura / INAH
sources.citation_text: Mexico's Secretaría de Cultura and INAH identify Moctezuma I as the Mexica ruler who reigned from 1440 to 1469.
